plain.text: "The king rejoices in your strength, LORD. How great is his joy in the victories you give!" God has granted the king's heart's desire. He placed a crown of pure gold on his head. The king asked for life, and God gave it, length of days forever. Through the victories God gave, his glory is great. God has made him glad with the joy of his presence. The king trusts in the LORD, and because of the unfailing love of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
The psalm describes the king's victory over his enemies. They plot evil against the LORD, but cannot succeed; they will be put to flight.
"Be exalted in your strength, LORD; we will sing and praise your might."

summary.bigIdea: The king celebrates the victories God has given and trusts in God's unfailing love.
points: The king rejoices in God's strength and blessing.
He will not be shaken because of the unfailing love of the Most High.
summary.reflection: The king's greatest gladness was "joy in Your presence". When have you sensed that joy?
